newsitem.title: USA: Vertex offering three mln shrs at $45.50.
newsitem.headline: Vertex offering three mln shrs at $45.50.

text.p: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc Thursday said it is offering 3,000,000 shares of common stock at a price of $45.50 each.
The issue will increase the number of Vertex common shares outstanding to 24,108,000.
Cowen & Co; Bear, Stearns & Co Inc.; Robertson, Stephens & Co; and J.P. Morgan & Co are managing the offering.
Vertex said it will use proceeds to fund research and product development programs, including clinical trials of the company's drug candidates, and for other general corporate purposes.
Vertex has granted to the underwriters an option to purchase up to 450,000 shares of common stock solely to cover over-allotments, if any.
